activeJobEmptyBody: When you accept and start a job it will appear here.
evidenceBeforeBody: Photograph the problem before you touch it. This protects you if the customer disputes the work later.
evidenceAfterBody: A photo of the finished work is your evidence if the customer disputes it later. Optional, but worth the ten seconds.
jobCustomerHidden: Customer details are shared once confirmed
jobFinishBody: The customer will be asked to approve the work. You will not be able to add photos afterwards.

jobWaitConfirm: Waiting for the customer to confirm the booking.
jobWaitApprove: Waiting for the customer to approve your work.
jobWaitPaid: Paid. Your earnings will appear in your wallet.
jobWaitDisputed: This job is under review by our team. We will be in touch.
